title: AI build chat: the plan card's dashed 「· 补充」 field chip has no legend and its tooltip shows only the machine name, so nothing says what "suggested" means
body: domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named producer. It reproduces on the tree and was measured by the #32984 os-dev (PR #33333, Acceptance notes, "The card's 'Also seen, smaller'"). It is split out of #32984 at that PR's merge (`ba32e79d`). Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot`). Grade p3, self-graded by the seat under the maintainer's 「定级你可以自己决定」: a wording gap on one chip, with no wrong data. Dedupe: `is:issue is:open suggestedField` and `is:issue is:open "补充" chatbot` find only #32984 itself. ## What the user sees On the AI build chat's plan card, a field the user's words did not name is drawn as a dashed chip ending in 「· 补充」 (en `· suggested`). Nothing on the card says what that mark means. The chip's tooltip (`title`) is the field's machine name, so hovering does not explain it either. ## Where (on `main` at `bd439f17`) - `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` `PlanCardObjectRows` (~L6164–6217): - `suggestedMark = t('chatbot.plan.suggestedField')` - the chip sets `title={f.name}` - `{f.suggested ? · {suggestedMark} : null}` - `chatbot.plan.suggestedField`: zh-Hans 「补充」, zh-Hant 「補充」, en `suggested`. ## Acceptance - A user can tell from the card what a suggested field is: the AI added it, and the user did not ask for it. This can be a one-line legend under the field rows when any field is suggested, or a tooltip sentence on the chip, through the i18n pack in every shipped locale. The machine name stays reachable. - Pin: a rendered plan card with one suggested and one named field shows the explanation for the suggested one only. CONTROL: with no suggested field, there is no legend. - ⛔ No producer change: `suggested` is already on the wire.
